title: Expedition Complete
text: The survey team is back at their camp, sand in everything, the manifest plate wrapped in a coat. Bede thanks every one of your units by its number. Marrow's shuttle is already on its way down for them.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Below it the region keeps its own time, waiting.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The Command Core's card lists every route, home included, when you're ready to go.

notes: onDone of dustfall. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
